svg.title: LIBERO-MAX lineage map with the supplied wordmark
svg.desc: The figure artwork, including a white wordmark disc and pale cool blue-gray halo, is retained as an embedded image. The supplied LIBERO-MAX wordmark remains editable vector paths, uniformly scaled without distortion.
